# SOP-OPS-014 Exchanger isolation (revision B)

## 1 Scope

This procedure applies to shell and tube exchangers E-201 to E-214 in the crude unit.

## 2 Isolation before opening

Close both block valves, open the bleed to the closed drain, confirm zero pressure on the local gauge and apply the isolation lock before breaking any flange. Venting to atmosphere is no longer permitted.
